WITH patient_avgs AS (
  SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) as patient_avg
  FROM Examination e
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_avgs AS (
  SELECT SEX, AVG(patient_avg) as A
  FROM patient_avgs
  GROUP BY SEX
),
b_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(A) as B
  FROM sex_avgs
  WHERE A IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT sex_avgs.SEX, sex_avgs.A, (sex_avgs.A - b_calc.B) as `A - B`
FROM sex_avgs
CROSS JOIN b_calc
WHERE sex_avgs.A IS NOT NULL AND b_calc.B IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sex_avgs.SEX
